item.title: No REAL ID yet? You can still fly, but it may cost $45 without another form of accepted ID
item.description: It isn't a penalty or a fine — it's payment for non-compliant travelers to use the Transportation Security Administration's new alternate identity verification option called ConfirmID.

item.title: Epstein files lead to resignation in Slovakia and calls in Britain for former prince to cooperate
item.description: The fallout comes just a day after the Justice Department began releasing a massive trove of files that offers more details about Epstein's interactions with the rich and famous after he served time for sex crimes in Florida.

item.title: Shooting at Louisiana parade leaves 5 people wounded, including 6-year-old , sheriff says
